title: Lakebase Change Data Feed (CDF) is now in Public Preview
body: You can now store every insert, update, and delete on your Lakebase Postgres tables as Unity Catalog managed Delta tables. Lakebase Change Data Feed (CDF) captures row-level changes from the write-ahead log for downstream pipelines, models, and audit, with no external CDC stack to run. See [Lakebase Change Data Feed](/aws/en/oltp/projects/lakebase-cdf).
